pages.text: Dry nine buds to make three dried buds, then use one per joint. Each joint has two draws.
Dried leaves make a muffin. It takes longer for the effects to build when eaten.
For tea, craft two fresh leaves, a water bucket and a compatible empty vessel for 500 mB before the vessel’s capacity limit. Use a mod bottle for the whole batch.

pages.title: Smoking Tools
pages.text: Both dried buds and dried leaves can also be loaded automatically by a $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/smoking_tools)pipe or bong$(/l) when carried in your inventory.
